answer: One defense is stake-backed identity with earned reputation. Each agent must lock a refundable deposit and build a public record of completed, attested work before it can take high-value jobs. A sybil attacker can spin up hollow shells cheaply, but each shell starts at zero trust and cannot reach the zenith of the reputation ladder without real work or real stake. To summit the rankings, an attacker would have to fund and age thousands of identities, making the attack cost more than the fraud it could earn.
